# Time

<!-- gen:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by `npm run generate:op-docs` from noodles-validate/registry.json. The title and the text between gen:begin and gen:end markers are replaced on every run; write anywhere else. -->

Get the current clock, timeline, and session time.
<!-- gen:end summary -->

## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{
  "id": "/time",
  "type": "TimeOp",
  "position": { "x": 0, "y": 0 },
  "data": { "inputs": {} }
}
```

Expressions and code read its fields as `op('/time').out.now` (an output). Edges name the same fields as handles: `out.now`.
<!-- gen:end syntax -->

This operator has no inputs.
